assign.request: spawn minions to try and integrate codrops (tympanus.net/codrops/) examples using the framework; create an imagine page for this, and keep this running at usage pace.
steps: build codrops/<slug>/page.js x3, substitute framework layout words

log.msg: Licence check: read the actual LICENSE file (never the badge) for 3 repos - GridItemHoverEffect, LineHoverStyles, OnScrollLetterAnimations, all Codrops MIT 2009-2020/21/22. Rejected MenuHoverEffects and PageRevealEffects: their README says 'do not redistribute' under a badge that reads MIT-ish - not this framework's MIT.

All 3 originals actually ship GSAP/Splitting.js/Locomotive Scroll (checked via github tree + package.json) despite being MIT-licensed - the MIT covers the idea/markup, not an obligation to vendor their JS. Rebuilt each mechanism in plain CSS/vanilla JS instead; documented as 'what changed' per demo.

layout skill's 3+-levels-deep rule bit for real: the 3 leaf pages under /imagine/codrops/ (itself under /imagine/) started on width:large and left 538-1562px of dead space to the right at 1920/3440 because they share evenly with the codrops index column. Switched all 3 to width:fill (a leaf claims the row's leftover) - measured dead space to ~0 after.

ui-test: drive.mjs's offscreen-x flag false-positived on the wide-viewport steps (stale vp.width closure, already filed 2026-09-04 by omnibox-prototype) - confirmed real state via doc.sw===doc.cw at 400/1280/1920/3440 on all 3 pages, zero real overflow. Zero console errors (only the still.png 404s before I generated them). Trigger proven with before/after screenshots: grid hover (corner reveal), 2 link hovers (scale+swap underline), and a scroll burst (visible letter-bend mid-scroll, confirmed via getBoundingClientRect deltas). prefers-reduced-motion verified with page.emulateMedia: scroll-bend's rAF loop never starts, both hover pages' transition-duration collapses to 0s.

Stills for the index cards are real Playwright screenshots (not live re-renders, per layout skill), cropped small (5-81KB, well under the 200KB fence) - had to widen the capture viewport to 1600px first since a narrow one squeezes a 3-levels-deep leaf column to ~260px (same columns-sharing effect as the width:fill fix).

documentation skill's own trap caught one: /imagine/codrops/readme/ (pretty route) 404s on page.js in console even though curl/SPA-fallback returns 200 - same as every sibling realm (vary/readme/ identical). Not a bug I introduced; fixed the links entry to the literal readme.md path instead.

assign.outcome: **Codrops realm lands: three MIT demos rebuilt on the framework's own words.** [`/imagine/codrops/`](/imagine/codrops/) opens with the owner's sentence, a card per demo (a real screenshot still + link to the original), and a data table (demo · original · licence link · what it needed · what changed). Three ports: [Grid item hover effect](/imagine/codrops/grid-hover/) (corner-reveal cards on `.grid.auto`+`--column`), [Menu hover effects](/imagine/codrops/line-hover/) (6 CSS-only underline styles on `.flex.wrap.gap`), [Scroll-based letter bend](/imagine/codrops/scroll-bend/) (rAF-driven bow effect, no scroll listener). All three originals ship GSAP/Splitting.js/Locomotive Scroll despite MIT licences read from the actual `LICENSE` file (not the badge) — every mechanism was reimplemented in plain CSS/vanilla JS instead of vendoring those; `MenuHoverEffects`/`PageRevealEffects` were rejected outright (their own README forbids redistribution under an MIT-ish badge). `ui-test` proved each trigger (hover×2, a scroll burst) with before/after screenshots — [shots/](/framework/ai/2026-09-05/codrops/shots/); zero console errors and zero real overflow at 400/1280/1920/3440 (drive.mjs's `offscreen-x` false-positived from its known stale-viewport bug, cross-checked against `scrollWidth===clientWidth`). `prefers-reduced-motion` verified with `page.emulateMedia`: the scroll loop never starts, both hover pages' transitions collapse to 0s. Caught and fixed one real layout bug along the way: all three leaf pages were on `width:large` and left 538–1562px of dead space at 1920/3440 (three-levels-deep sharing evenly with the `large` parent) — switched to `width:fill`. [`readme.md`](/imagine/codrops/readme.md) carries the porting rules for round 2. Left for a future round: the 9 SVG-stroke link styles and the direction-aware pointer variants of the grid hover.
